hero.title: Want a clean, tidy home in Beer Sheva?
hero.subtitle:
Household management in Beer Sheva: cleaning, tidying and whatever else your home needs.
Book on WhatsApp with the button below, and we'll find a time that works for you.

services.title: Deep cleaning and tidying
services.text: A thorough clean of every corner of the home: behind furniture, inside cabinets, tiles, windows and window tracks. We'll estimate the time together by phone.

services.title: Regular cleaning
services.text: Cleaning the whole home every week or two: dusting, floors, kitchen and bathrooms, so you always come back to a clean home.

services.title: Household management
services.text: Laundry and ironing, changing bedding, dishes and whatever else the home needs, together with the cleaning in the same visit.

services.title: Home organizing
services.text: Organizing closets, the kitchen and pantry, and kids' rooms. I organize homes in Beer Sheva so it's easy for you to keep things tidy after the visit.

services.title: Move-in and move-out cleaning
services.text: Cleaning before you move in or after you move out, so you get or hand over a spotless apartment.

services.title: After-renovation cleaning
services.text: Removing construction dust, paint stains and silicone leftovers until the home is ready to live in.

services.title: Passover and holiday cleaning
services.text: A thorough clean of the kitchen, cabinets and the whole home before Passover or any other holiday. We'll estimate the time together by phone.

about.title: Nice to meet you
about.text:
I'm Ayelet, and I've been managing households in Beer Sheva for many years. Most of my clients stay with me for years and book me regularly, which to me is the greatest compliment.
A clean, tidy home isn't just a shiny floor. It's folded laundry, fresh bedding, dishes put away, and more free time for you.
I work thoroughly, responsibly and with respect for your home, and every home gets the same care from me, just like my own.

area.title: Service area
area.text: Home cleaning and organizing all over Beer Sheva.

faq.q: How much does house and apartment cleaning in Beer Sheva cost?
faq.a: {rate} per hour, and {eveningRate} per hour in the evening (from {eveningFrom}). Minimum {hours} hours per visit, then by the half hour. The price is final.

faq.q: What if the visit runs past {eveningFrom}?
faq.a: The hours until {eveningFrom} are charged at {rate} per hour, and the hours after {eveningFrom} at {eveningRate} per hour.

faq.q: What else can I ask for besides cleaning?
faq.a: Laundry and ironing, changing bedding, dishes, tidying — whatever the home needs, in the same visit. Just mention it in your WhatsApp message.
Send a WhatsApp message or call, and we'll set a day and time.

faq.q: What if I need to cancel?
faq.a: You can cancel free of charge up to two days before the visit. Cancelling later than that costs {cancellationFee}.

faq.q: Do I need to provide cleaning supplies?
faq.a: Yes. I work with the cleaning supplies you have at home, so please have them ready before the visit.

faq.q: Which neighborhoods in Beer Sheva do you cover?
faq.a: Every neighborhood in Beer Sheva, from the Old City to Ramot and Neve Ze'ev.

faq.q: Can I book a regular cleaning?
faq.a: Yes, weekly or every two weeks on a fixed day.

faq.q: Do I need to be home during the cleaning?
faq.a: No. You can leave me a key, and we'll agree in advance how I return it.

faq.q: How many hours will I need?
faq.a: A 2–3-room apartment usually needs the minimum of 4 hours. A 4-room apartment usually takes 4 hours too, unless it needs a serious tidy-up, and 5 rooms or more about 5 hours. That's an estimate, not a commitment. For deep cleaning and tidying or a Passover cleaning, I give a personal estimate by phone after we go over what the home needs.
By Bit, PayBox, cash or bank transfer.

accessibilityService: The service takes place in the client's home, and the business has no premises open to the public. If you need any adjustment, for example arranging things by phone instead of in writing, a visit at a particular time, or a detailed explanation in advance, contact me by phone or WhatsApp and I'll gladly adapt the service.
